consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the 5/19/77 show at the Fox Theater is one of the best performances of the year, with standout versions of classic songs. The jamming and cohesion between band members, especially Jerry Garcia's guitar work, are frequently praised, making this show a must-listen for any Deadhead.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 56 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The show is frequently described as perfect or among the best of all time, reflecting high enthusiasm from reviewers.
